g.text: ‘Law & Order: SVU’ Sets Stephanie March to Return as Alexandra Cabot ◆ Ethan Klein Reacts to Hila Klein’s Cheating Allegations Amid ‘H3 Podcast’ Fallout: ‘Please Respect My Family’s Privacy … They Have Nothing to Do With This’ ◆ Blumhouse Soliciting Testimony from Anyone Who Feels ‘Personally Victimized’ by One of Its Movies or TV Shows ◆ Hunter Biden Signs With CAA ◆ ‘Killing a Bear,’ From Movistar Plus and Arte France: a Real-Event Inspired Murder-Mystery Whose Victim Is a Pyrenean Brown Bear ◆ Did Karen Bass Expand Film Incentives?
